title: OrcaRalphState
description: Schema for Ralph autonomous task execution state tracking in Orca.

session_id.description: Unique session identifier for the autonomous execution.

project_name.description: Name of the target project or repository.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the Ralph loop.

max_iterations.description: Safety threshold to prevent runaway execution.

active_task_id.description: ID of the task currently being executed.

completed_tasks.description: List of successfully verified task IDs.

failed_tasks.description: List of task IDs that failed evaluation.

retry_counts.description: Map of task_id to retry count.

git_head_commit.description: Current git commit hash tracking state.
